description: This is a Linux kernel driver source file for the PTM (Packet Transfer Mode) network interface, specifically for VR9 hardware. It includes core functions for initializing, configuring, and managing the PTM device, handling network packet transmission and reception, and interfacing with hardware registers and descriptors.

methods.name: ptm_showtime_enter
methods.description: Enters showtime mode, sets up hardware registers, and activates network interfaces.

methods.name: ptm_showtime_exit
methods.description: Exits showtime mode, resets hardware registers, and deactivates network interfaces.

methods.name: ltq_ptm_probe
methods.description: Initializes the driver, allocates network devices, registers them, and sets up hardware and interrupts.

methods.name: ltq_ptm_remove
methods.description: Cleans up driver resources, unregisters devices, and disables hardware.

methods.name: ptm_setup
methods.description: Configures a network device with operation callbacks and MAC address.

methods.name: ptm_get_stats
methods.description: Returns network statistics for the device.

methods.name: ptm_open
methods.description: Starts the network device, enabling NAPI and starting the queue.

methods.name: ptm_stop
methods.description: Stops the network device, disables NAPI, and stops the queue.

methods.name: ptm_poll
methods.description: Handles packet reception by processing descriptors and passing packets to the network stack.

methods.name: ptm_napi_poll
methods.description: NAPI poll function that calls ptm_poll and manages interrupt masking.

methods.name: ptm_hard_start_xmit
methods.description: Transmits a packet by preparing descriptors and writing to hardware.

methods.name: ptm_change_mtu
methods.description: Adjusts the MTU size of the network device.

methods.name: ptm_ioctl
methods.description: Handles ioctl commands for retrieving and setting device parameters.

methods.name: ptm_tx_timeout
methods.description: Handles transmission timeout events.

methods.name: alloc_skb_rx
methods.description: Allocates a socket buffer for receiving data.

methods.name: alloc_skb_tx
methods.description: Allocates a socket buffer for transmitting data.

methods.name: get_skb_pointer
methods.description: Retrieves the skb pointer from a dataptr.

methods.name: get_tx_desc
methods.description: Gets a free transmit descriptor.

methods.name: mailbox_irq_handler
methods.description: Interrupt handler for mailbox events.

methods.name: do_swap_desc_tasklet
methods.description: Tasklet for handling swap descriptors.

methods.name: ifx_ptm_version
methods.description: Retrieves the firmware version string.

methods.name: init_priv_data
methods.description: Initializes private data structures and configuration.

methods.name: clear_priv_data
methods.description: Clears private data structures.

methods.name: init_tables
methods.description: Initializes hardware descriptors and configuration tables.

methods.name: clear_tables
methods.description: Clears hardware descriptors and configurations.
